Delta Corp swings to ₹80.0 Cr Q2 loss after GST provision

A ₹319.6 Cr GST provision drove the loss, and revenue fell to ₹126.9 Cr from ₹133.4 Cr a year earlier. Far larger show-cause GST demands remain.

▼ Negative · High ⚠ governance risk · ⚠ cash risk · ⚠ guidance cut · earnings impact highHistory: after 7,608 'Outcome of Board Meeting' filings, the stock beat the market over the next 5 sessions 43% of the time (median -0.8%)

DELTACORP · Exchange filing, read by AI · Mon 19 Oct, 8:36 PM Read ↗

Quarter ended Sep-26: revenue ₹126.9 Cr vs ₹133.4 Cr a year earlier (Sep-25 quarter ₹133.4 Cr; Jun-26 quarter ₹116.9 Cr); net loss ₹80.0 Cr vs ₹(40.3) Cr... see note: Sep-26 quarter loss ₹80.0 Cr, Sep-25 quarter profit ₹10.2 Cr tax-adjusted.

Half-year to Sep-26 net loss ₹(189.3) Cr, mainly from ₹319.6 Cr GST provision booked as an exceptional item (₹200.6 Cr in Jun-26 quarter).

Show-cause GST demands total far larger (₹16,823 Cr, ₹6,384 Cr, ₹1,884 Cr) but company has stayed/contested most; ₹49 Cr principal already paid, Daman hotel flooded 37 days, Sikkim casino closed.
